scope: Positive native verification of the skin's migrated addon lifecycle labels/visibility and corrected textbox paging context. Existing external addon code and production XML unchanged.

sources.finding: The modern lifecyclestate metadata element supplies normal/deprecated/broken state and localized reason; test fixtures use this actual reader contract.
Lifecycle type returns localized strings 24169/24170/24171 and lifecycle description returns the native addon reason.
Published master retains these lifecycle labels and string IDs.
Published master retains lifecyclestate metadata parsing.
Page spin controls use native page type; factory explicitly sets reverse=false, overriding the generic skin default.
With reverse=false, PageUp action invokes PageDown() which adds ten pages; ChangePage notifies the linked control.
Textbox sends its line count/page size to its pagecontrol and accepts page-change messages from that control.

fixture: Three own disabled installed script metadata fixtures, never executed; normal short description and deprecated/broken identical controlled 180-line descriptions with different lifecycle reasons. Actual addonbrowser Info action, no injected lifecycle property values.
observation: ID-only hooks on existing page group, warning banner, reason textbox and page label in isolated DialogAddonInfo.xml; original expressions/types/layout unchanged, original XML restored.
results: Normal short: type/reason correct, one page, banner and page indicator hidden.
Deprecated: localized type/reason correct, warning banner and yellow warning icon shown; 19 pages and native paging from 1 to 11.
Broken: localized type/reason correct, broken icon shown; native paging from 11 to 19 and HasNext=false at end.
Return to normal short: banner and page indicator hidden, page 1/1, no stale warning.
Final run has no ERROR lines; own process exits, secured settings/addon DB file sets restored, fixtures removed from addon directory, all skin XML matches.

intermediate_attempt.finding: Lifecycle states and initial multi-page visibility passed; helper chose PageDown at page 1 and incorrectly expected advancement. Source shows inverse page-spin action naming. Test changed to PageUp; no product fix. Attempt has no ERROR lines and all cleanup checks passed.

limits: Identical long description text retains page offset between deprecated and broken fixtures; not a claim that every different addon description starts on page one.

Only English localization, installed metadata fixtures, 16:9 and title/description/visibility/paging. Remote repository states, language changes, actual same-addon lifecycle transitions and provider actions are not runtime-tested.
No full addon-info layout review, every page transition or pointer/scroll interaction approval.
No product rewrite justified by these cases; current package remains unchanged.
